nodes.label: The game-ideas catalogue is explicitly early-stage brainstorming rather than a commitment, covering twenty possible social, economic, political, linguistic, folkloric, and narrative systems.

Candidate systems include factions, multidimensional reputation, secrets and confession, tenancy and land agents, trade and craft, Catholic Emancipation, a blow-in newcomer arc, Irish-language progression, and letters.

The brainstorm prioritizes reputation, weather storytelling, and the blow-in arc highest; factions, secrets, fairy encounters, and the holy well are medium; land, crafts, poitín, and Irish progression follow later.
